states.name: START
states.meaning: Reset/initial state before the first 1 has been converted; z=0. On x=0 remains START; on x=1, the first 1 is copied to z=1 and the machine enters INV1.
states.update_time: asynchronously when Reset is asserted; on posedge clk when Reset is deasserted

states.name: INV0
states.meaning: A 1 has already been seen, so subsequent bits are inverted; current Moore output z=0. On x=0, z becomes 1 and state becomes INV1; on x=1, z remains 0 and state remains INV0.
states.update_time: posedge clk when Reset is deasserted

states.name: INV1
states.meaning: A 1 has already been seen, so subsequent bits are inverted; current Moore output z=1. On x=0, z remains 1 and state remains INV1; on x=1, z becomes 0 and state becomes INV0.
states.update_time: posedge clk when Reset is deasserted

rules.condition: Reset is asserted; asynchronous reset forces START and z=0. The example and reset object use areset=1 as the asserted level under an active-high/reset-to-zero interpretation; see uncertain for polarity/reset-value ambiguity.

Reset is deasserted and clk posedge samples x. Serial 2's-complement conversion proceeds LSB first: while START has not yet seen a 1, the new z is x (x=0 stays START/z=0; x=1 enters INV1/z=1). After a 1 has been seen, the new z is ~x, represented by INV0 (z=0) and INV1 (z=1). Output is the Moore state value after the sampled posedge has settled.

reset.name: areset
reset.first_released_cycle: The first sampled posedge clk after Reset is deasserted; Reset assertion asynchronously returns the state to START and stops conversion.

before.mid: If a vector row contains mid, those input changes occur after that row's sampled posedge and before the next edge; the changed values carry to the start of the next row.

uncertain.note: The specification requires an asynchronous reset but does not explicitly state polarity or the exact output while reset is asserted; z=0 and areset=1 in the example are an active-high/reset-to-zero interpretation.
candidates: active-high areset with z=0 while reset is asserted
active-low areset with z=0 while reset is asserted
active level unspecified; reset value of z unspecified or previous

candidates: pre-posedge Moore output, delaying the first converted bit by one observation cycle
